identity.title: nginx + PHP
identity.summary: Adminer database manager: nginx → FastCGI → PHP-FPM, backed by SQLite.

guide.title: nginx + PHP demo
guide.summary: The web preview is Adminer, auto-connected to a SQLite database that PHP-FPM seeds on first load. These actions inspect the same live FastCGI stack from a shell.

actions.label: Status page
actions.description: Fetch the PHP-FPM status page at /info.php.

actions.label: SQLite file
actions.description: Show the demo database PHP-FPM created (SQLite header included).

script.title: Service check
script.initialText:
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/info.php | sed -n '1,40p'
echo "--- SQLite database (seeded by PHP-FPM on first load) ---"
ls -l /var/www/data && head -c 16 /var/www/data/demo.db; echo
echo "--- service processes ---"
lsof | grep -E 'nginx|php-fpm' | head -60 || true
